defmodule PooledSerializer do
  @moduledoc """
  A connection-pooled serialization library that handles
  structured data encoding with audit logging.
  """

  use GenServer

  defstruct [:pool_name, :max_connections, :log_backend, :codec]

  # Pool configuration
  @default_pool_size 10
  @log_separator "\n"

  def start_link(opts) do
    pool_name = Keyword.get(opts, :pool_name, :default_pool)
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: pool_name)
  end

  def init(opts) do
    state = %__MODULE__{
      pool_name: Keyword.get(opts, :pool_name, :default_pool),
      max_connections: Keyword.get(opts, :pool_size, @default_pool_size),
      log_backend: Keyword.get(opts, :log_backend, &default_log_backend/1),
      codec: Keyword.get(opts, :codec, :etf)
    }
    {:ok, state}
  end

  @doc """
  Serialize a term and log the operation for audit purposes.
  The metadata map allows callers to attach context (user, session, etc).
  """
  def serialize(pool, term, metadata \\ %{}) do
    GenServer.call(pool, {:serialize, term, metadata})
  end

  @doc """
  Deserialize binary data back to a term with audit logging.
  """
  def deserialize(pool, binary, metadata \\ %{}) do
    GenServer.call(pool, {:deserialize, binary, metadata})
  end

  def handle_call({:serialize, term, metadata}, _from, state) do
    result = do_serialize(term, state.codec)
    audit_entry = build_audit_entry(:serialize, metadata, result, state)
    state.log_backend.(audit_entry)
    {:reply, result, state}
  end

  def handle_call({:deserialize, binary, metadata}, _from, state) do
    result = do_deserialize(binary, state.codec)
    audit_entry = build_audit_entry(:deserialize, metadata, result, state)
    state.log_backend.(audit_entry)
    {:reply, result, state}
  end

  defp do_serialize(term, :etf), do: {:ok, :erlang.term_to_binary(term)}
  defp do_serialize(term, :json), do: Jason.encode(term)
  defp do_serialize(_term, codec), do: {:error, {:unknown_codec, codec}}

  defp do_deserialize(binary, :etf) do
    try do
      {:ok, :erlang.binary_to_term(binary, [:safe])}
    rescue
      _ -> {:error, :decode_failed}
    end
  end
  defp do_deserialize(binary, :json), do: Jason.decode(binary)
  defp do_deserialize(_binary, codec), do: {:error, {:unknown_codec, codec}}

  @doc false
  defp build_audit_entry(operation, metadata, result, state) do
    timestamp = DateTime.utc_now() |> DateTime.to_iso8601()
    status = case result do
      {:ok, _} -> "success"
      {:error, reason} -> "error:#{inspect(reason)}"
    end

    # Build structured log line from metadata
    meta_fields = metadata
    |> Enum.map(fn {k, v} -> format_field(k, v) end)
    |> Enum.join(" ")

    "[#{timestamp}] pool=#{state.pool_name} op=#{operation} status=#{status} #{meta_fields}"
  end

  @doc """
  Format a single metadata field for the audit log.
  Keys are atoms (trusted), values come from callers.
  """
  defp format_field(key, value) when is_atom(key) do
    sanitized_value = sanitize_log_value(value)
    "#{key}=#{sanitized_value}"
  end

  @doc """
  Sanitize a value for safe inclusion in structured logs.
  Removes control characters that could inject log entries.
  """
  defp sanitize_log_value(value) when is_binary(value) do
    value
    |> String.replace("\n", "")
    |> String.replace("\r", "")
    |> String.replace(<<0x1b>>, "")
    |> truncate_value(256)
  end
  defp sanitize_log_value(value) when is_integer(value), do: Integer.to_string(value)
  defp sanitize_log_value(value) when is_atom(value), do: Atom.to_string(value)
  defp sanitize_log_value(value), do: inspect(value) |> sanitize_log_value()

  defp truncate_value(str, max_len) do
    if String.length(str) > max_len do
      String.slice(str, 0, max_len) <> "..."
    else
      str
    end
  end

  defp default_log_backend(entry) do
    File.write!("audit.log", entry <> @log_separator, [:append])
  end

  # Connection pool checkout/checkin helpers
  def checkout(pool, timeout \\ 5000) do
    GenServer.call(pool, :checkout, timeout)
  end

  def checkin(pool, conn) do
    GenServer.cast(pool, {:checkin, conn})
  end

  def handle_call(:checkout, _from, state) do
    {:reply, {:ok, make_ref()}, state}
  end

  def handle_cast({:checkin, _conn}, state) do
    {:noreply, state}
  end
end
